pages.title: The Factory Knows
pages.text: Connect demand to production; precision mechanisms and sheets expand the factory you demonstrated.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Link ingredient gauges to output stock, processing address and batch size. Native crafter auto-arrangement uses a recognized recipe and wrench-connected grid; consolidate fragments with a Re-Packager.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Connect ingredient gauges, set batch output and processing destination, and return products to linked stock. Issue ingredient requests when output stock is low; each gauge maintains its own target.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Enable a recognized crafting recipe's auto-arrangement and deliver it to a wrench-connected crafter grid. Unpack ingredients into their crafting slots; Re-Packagers help prevent fragmented orders.
